The binding amendments E1..E11 below answer spec review T-0067 and win over anything else.

E1 Timestamps. The client owns updated_at (ISO, set on every local write from Date.now()). New migration supabase/migrations/20261010170000_sync_columns.sql: add `synced_at timestamptz not null default now()` to profiles, items, scenes, conversations; replace the four set_updated_at triggers with set_synced_at triggers (new function public.set_synced_at sets new.synced_at = now(); drop function public.set_updated_at); add indexes (user_id, synced_at) per table; add to items: `place text, object_id text, image_path text`; add to conversations: `place text`. Update the header comment of the init migration only if it still says Clerk (comment-only edit).
